clips.title: The story
paras: The Fathom Core is a specialized relic recovered from a submerged fathom stone in the depths of Blackfathom Deeps. When deciphered, it provides a comprehensive record of elemental activity in the surrounding region. The Earthen Ring seeks this artifact to discern what dark rituals the Twilight's Hammer cult is conducting beneath Ashenvale.

Resting within an ancient fathom stone submerged among the Moonshrine Ruins, the Fathom Core serves as a historical record for elemental phenomena. It registers and preserves shifts, disruptions, and surges in the elements over time. For the shaman of the Earthen Ring stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost, acquiring the core is essential for understanding how the Twilight's Hammer cultists are manipulating the regional elements to serve their own ends.
